label: Heavy going
summary: A grey, unsettled Thanksgiving. An explosion shook Sanaa as Houthi missiles were intercepted over Riyadh, Kim Jong Un urged wider deployment of tactical nuclear weapons, and Ukraine said it struck five planes at a Russian base. Washington announced new tariffs of 10 to 20 percent on 14 trading partners while tech stocks swung on AI doubts. King tides charged by El Niño soaked San Francisco and pushed New York's parade to Saturday, and a flooded mine in Indonesia left eight dead and 18 trapped. There were gentler notes too. The UN said famine risk had eased in Somalia's Baidoa, land near the site of the first Thanksgiving was returned to Native American ownership, South Korea raised its growth forecast, and Colombia's supermarket siege ended with hostages freed. The weighted formula gave 39; no editorial adjustment.
